text: 你拼命奔逃，希望能甩开那个看不见的杀手，一道如电般的剧痛从肩膀撕裂到腰部。滚烫的血从背后喷涌而出。
你的双腿终于支撑不住，整个人摔倒在地。刺骨寒意包围你，肉体接连被无情地撕开。你最后一次试图触碰那个隐形灵体，试图理解它；双手在空中乱抓，直到失血与休克耗尽你最后的力量。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 441
text: As you race away, hoping against hope to outdistance the invisible murderer, an electric streak of agony tears from your shoulder to your waist. A hot well of blood fountains down your back.

Your legs finally give out and you crash to the earth. As bitter cold surrounds you, your flesh parts in a merciless series of wounds. You make a last attempt to touch the invisible spirit, to somehow understand; clawing your hands through empty air until blood loss and shock saps your final reserves of strength.
